answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 3947 Country: Canada Title: I need answer to the following question within three days please. Is performing salah at non-Muslim's house permissible? Please answer to this question within three days. Question: Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem. Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu, I need answer to the following question within three days please. Is performing salah at non-Muslim's house permissible? Please answer to this question within three days. Jazakallah khairan wassalaamu alaikum. Answer ID: 3947 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 113/113=M) It is allowed to pray salah in non-Muslim's house provided the place where salah is offered is tahir (pure/clean): وفی الدر المختار: ھی طھارۃ بدنہ من حدث و خبث و ثوبہ و مکانہ ای موضع قدمیہ او احداھما ان رفع الاخری، و موضع سجودہ اتفاقاً فی الاصح الخ۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
